lines.D01: Thinking about getting a Cosy2Rise? Here are five questions we hear a lot.
lines.D02: An electric 7-zone slatted frame. It replaces your current slatted frame.
lines.D03: The backrest rises separately up to 60 degrees – for reading or watching TV.
lines.D04: The whole lying surface tilts gently up to 5.5 degrees – evenly and stably, instead of loose pillows.
lines.D06: Yes. Cosy2Rise is TÜV and GS certified and made in Europe.
lines.D07: Cosy2Rise. Make more of your bed.
